name: relay_ssh

Mirror the Kotlin descriptor row in RELAY_TRANSPORT_REGISTRATIONS with matching capability fields (tcp=true, udp=false, reusable=false, supports_outbound_bind_ip=false) and a build_ssh backend builder.
